description: RAG evaluation quality thresholds - initial defaults based on industry standards (RAGAS) and internal targets

notes.tool_accuracy: Internal standard - LLM tool selection should be highly accurate for 5 well-defined tools
notes.faithfulness: RAGAS recommended threshold - measures groundedness of answers
notes.answer_relevancy: RAGAS recommended threshold - keyword coverage proxy
notes.recall_at_5: Industry standard - top 5 retrieval results should contain expected documents
notes.filter_accuracy: Internal standard - allows some NLP parsing tolerance
notes.success_rate: Allows up to 5% API errors including timeouts
